source.name: Sportcal: 'Cadbury extends Wallabies partnership through 2029'
source.quote: the partnership through 2029, sees Cadbury continue as the principal partner of the team, with its branding remaining on the front of Wallabies shirts

source.name: Rugby Australia: 'Rugby Australia and Castore announce new landmark partnership'
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.
source.quote: the Wallabies, Wallaroos, Australian Men’s and Women’s Sevens teams and Australian Pathways teams proudly wearing Castore-issued sportswear from January 2026

summary: Cadbury (owned by US-listed Mondelez International) on the front; Castore makes the kit. Nothing found on either.
